mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 70 degrees at Harriet Park with clear skies. The moon is in its Waxing Gibbous phase, and if you are a night owl, you can catch the ISS passing over Mount Horeb at 3:25 AM, moving high in the sky toward the Madison area near Home Depot for one minute. We expect an overnight low of 58 degrees with no rain predicted.
We have no new important emails to share with residents today, though our police department remains hard at work keeping our streets safe.

Today you can head over to Insight Wellness for yoga. Looking ahead to tomorrow, we have plenty of fun options including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and our weekly farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park.
In our weekly report, on August 17, Verona police officers successfully located and arrested a 21-year-old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road for a probation violation.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. They are open until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to satisfy your sweet tooth.
